message.content: The incident has been assessed with a severity of 1.0 (low), calculated as DPC 2 x EI 0.25 + CB 0.5 [F02][F03][F04]. Because the data was unintelligible to the recipient due to full disk AES-256 encryption with a separate TPM pin, the ease of identification is negligible [F03]. Under GDPR Art. 33(1), this breach is unlikely to result in a risk to data subjects [F03][F04]. Consequently, no supervisory authority notification is required, and the incident will be documented internally only [F05][F07].
